integrity: Proof, count formula, direct spectrum checker, and reproducibility instructions are self-contained. No external or independent mathematical validation has been claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification applies only to linear binary words with two ones and a fixed common zero total; not an unrestricted congruence count. Historic priority may remain incomplete; finite checks supplement rather than replace the all-length argument.
title: Exact fixed-content Simon-congruence classes for binary two-marker words
